task.description: Reserve req, then release that same req only if reservation succeeded. Final occupancy equals original.

methods.name: Reserve
methods.header:
method Reserve(used: int, req: int, cap: int) returns (next: int, ok: bool)
  requires 0 <= used <= cap
  requires req >= 0
  ensures ok == (used + req <= cap)
  ensures next == (if ok then used + req else used)
  ensures 0 <= next <= cap

methods.name: Release
methods.header:
method Release(used: int, req: int) returns (next: int, ok: bool)
  requires used >= 0 && req >= 0
  ensures ok == (req <= used)
  ensures next == (if ok then used - req else used)
  ensures next >= 0

methods.name: ReserveRelease
methods.header:
method ReserveRelease(used: int, req: int, cap: int) returns (next: int)
  requires 0 <= used <= cap && req >= 0
  ensures next == used
